chats.answer:
For a 3-in-1 MagSafe charging station (iPhone + Apple Watch + AirPods), I'd prioritize active cooling, not just charging speed.

Wireless charging generates heat, especially at 15–25W. A charger with a built-in fan can help keep your iPhone cooler and reduce the chance of thermal throttling.

My buying criteria would be:

Active cooling fan — ideally directed at the back of the iPhone.

Qi2 25W or certified MagSafe — for efficient magnetic alignment and fast charging.

Quiet operation — especially important for a bedside charger.

Apple Watch fast charging — not every 3-in-1 station supports it.
